kind: documentation mapping; not a new wire schema

h3_events.name: search_submitted
h3_events.meaning: Valid explicit search submission; not every results visit

h3_events.name: results_viewed
h3_events.meaning: Received page outcome including empty/error, direct entry and pagination; not proof of visual attention

h3_events.name: offer_details_opened
h3_events.meaning: Disclosure/dialog opened; do not alias to DEAL_VIEW

h3_events.name: affiliate_clicked
h3_events.meaning: Browser intent for flight/stay/activity; not server redirect or booking

h3_events.name: budget_started
h3_events.meaning: First valid changed nonempty field per visit/context; not calculator visibility

h3_events.name: budget_calculated
h3_events.meaning: No explicit completion event; reactive partial totals are not full budgets

h3_events.name: trip_saved
h3_events.meaning: Successful new local snapshot write; no plan or budget payload

h3_events.name: trip_updated
h3_events.meaning: No persistent plan Update operation yet; depends on H3-12

h3_events.name: event_clicked
h3_events.meaning: Event ticket interaction; ACTIVITY_CLICK is a separate attraction action

h3_events.name: alert_opt_in
h3_events.meaning: Successful email confirmation with analytics consent; not ALERT_STARTED or Telegram opt-in

consent.revocation: stop future browser sends; clear local session; does not delete prior server records

delivery.mode: best effort keepalive fetch, no retry
delivery.view_dedupe: per URL visit plus event/context/session; reload or return is a new visit

timestamp: server received created_at UTC; not client action time
baseline_population: consenting received product-event sessions, not all site visitors
